response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and significant production experience at scale, he lacks the critical domain expertise in experimentation platforms, metrics infrastructure, and data-driven analysis that is central to this Principal Engineer role. His background is in full-stack web and infrastructure engineering rather than growth and experimentation systems. The resume shows no evidence of A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, telemetry systems, statistical analysis, or rollout-risk management—all core requirements for this position.
strengths: Extensive technical breadth with production experience at scale (handled millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby with real-time systems)
Strong software engineering practices demonstrated through TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, and proficiency across multiple languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, Java, C#, D)
Proven ability to architect platforms and build foundational systems (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial frameworks) with mentoring through workshops and community engagement
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature-flagging systems, or rollout management critical to this growth-focused role
Missing core data aptitude: no background in metrics infrastructure, telemetry systems, statistical analysis, or experimental design
Limited evidence of Principal/IC6-level technical leadership; most roles are senior individual contributors without clear multi-team architectural influence or cross-functional stakeholder alignment
